units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1:17">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>האומר … שפתותיו רוֹחֲשׁוֹת עמו בקבר</he> if one reports a tradition in the name of its author, his (the author’s) lips move in the grave with him (the reporter); Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ bot.; Y. Shek. II, end, 47ᵃ.

Men. V, 8 (63ᵃ) מרחשת … ומעשיה רוֹחֲשִׁין (Bab. ed. רוחשין רכין; Ms. M. only רכין, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a marḥesheth is deep, and the pastry made in it vibrates (like jelly), opp. קשין; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 10, ch. XII; Lev. R. s. 3, end; Yalk. ib. 451.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>; Pesik. Ul’ḳaḥ., p. 184ᵃ sq., v. <cite ref="D00429"><he>דָּחַס</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: with לב, to be moved, to feel, think.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 45:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLV, 2</cite> <he>לא יכלו … אלא כיון שר׳ לבם בתשובה וכ׳</he> they could not confess with their lips, but when their heart was moved in repentance, the Lord received them.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 45:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אם בלבנו רָחַשְׁנוּ וכ׳</he> if we only have been thinking in our hearts, we have already told our deeds to the Lord; a. e.
<cite ref="Pesachim 88b:12">Pes. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>הטילו … ורִיחֲשָׁה</he> they poured cold water upon it (the lizard), and it moved. Y. Shek. l. c., v. supra.

senses.gloss: to move (the lips); to whisper, think. Y. Ber. IV, beg. 7ᵃ (ref. to I Sam. I, 13) מיכן … להַרְחִישׁ בשפתותיו from this we learn that he who prays must move his lips.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 17:7">Ex. XVII, 7</cite>) [read:] <he>אם מַרְחִישִׁים אנו בקרבנו דברים והוא יודע מה אנו מרחישים בקרבנו וכ׳</he> if we think words in our hearts, and he knows what we think in our hearts, we will worship him; (<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26:2">Ex. R. s. 26</cite> <he>מהרהרים</he>).

senses.gloss: to swarm, come forth (of worms); to bring forth (worms).
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:10:2">Koh. R. to V, 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 25:6">Job XXV, 6</cite>) <he>אלו תולעים שמַרְחִישִׁין תחתיו במותו</he> that means the worms which come forth under him when he is dead.
Gen. R. s. 23 התחיל המת מרחיש (not מרחש) corpses began to beget worms; a. e.—Trnsf. to bring forth in abundance.
